title: XL Titanium Condenser W/ O-Rings
description:
The XL Titanium Condenser will fit most 109mm vapcaps and comes with all three o-rings needed to install the condenser.
Please Note: current XL condenser is the latest from dynavap and has a subtle pattern milled into the condenser.
Included
1 x XL Condenser
3 x Condenser O-Rings
